Exploring Evolutionary Spirituality

Tim Freke and Andrew Cohen, London 4th November

Andrew and bestselling author T!M FREKE are bold and outspoken pioneers in the field of evolutionary spirituality. Their vision of spiritual awakening brings together the perennial experience of enlightenment with the awesome revelations of modern science, cosmology and evolution.

In this dynamic and thought-provoking dialogue, two inspiring teachers will strive for a shared and higher understanding of how to make the spiritual path truly relevant to contemporary culture.

Tickets are available now via the booking link below. Watch these videos to see what Tim and Andrew will each bring to the table!
